subject: Pattern fill scale for b/w printing?

messages.author: 1b1f6bd7cf1931ba
messages.subject: Pattern fill scale for b/w printing?
parts:
Hi!

I was wondering if there are any fill scales (for bar charts) for
black-and-white printing, other than the greyscale?

I have a faceted, grouped bar chart with 5 different bar colors and I
think it is kind of hard to discern the colors on a bw printout,
especially with the grey background.

Are there any pattern fills in ggplot2? Or any other way to make the
data look nicer?

Best Regards
Martin

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Pattern fill scale for b/w printing?
parts:
Hi Martin,

I'd like to be able to implement pattern fills, but unfortunately
ggplot2 is built on top of the grid package, and grid currently
doesn't support patterns.

Hadley
